visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a manicured hand holding a boxed product in a bright retail store aisle. The hand, wearing gold rings, is the focal point against a background of blurred shelves filled with skincare products. (2) The scene shifts to a cosmetic display stand for 'THE FLOWER SHOP.' A hand picks up a beige tube of color-correcting base and rotates it. The lighting is even and studio-like, highlighting the product textures. (3) The hand is shown picking a white tube with purple accents from a dense supermarket shelf of hair care products. The shelf is organized with multiple rows of various bottles. (4) A gold cylindrical Anessa sunscreen brush is held. The hand removes the cap, revealing a thick brush head, and then demonstrates brushing the product onto the back of a pale wrist in a smooth motion. (5) A round, light-blue patterned powder compact from 'excel' is picked up and presented. The hand holds it steady to show the shell-like texture of the lid. (6) The camera focuses on a display of Canmake bases. A hand picks up a small pink bottle, followed by a beige one, holding them close to the lens. (7) The final phase shows a blurred drugstore background with a text overlay asking a question, followed by a graphic page containing a QR code and social media logos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring a driving synth beat. A female narrator enters with a friendly, energetic tone. A subtle 'pop' SFX accompanies the first text graphic. (2) As the narrator describes the color base, her speech rate is moderately fast. A soft rustling sound of plastic packaging is heard as the product is handled. BGM remains constant. (3) Transitioning to hair care, a quick 'whoosh' SFX is used. The narrator's pitch rises slightly to emphasize excitement. The BGM beat continues at a steady 124 BPM. (4) During the Anessa sunscreen segment, a distinct 'click' SFX occurs when the cap is opened, followed by the faint sound of brush bristles rubbing. Narration is clear and well-articulated. (5) The narrator's tone becomes more appreciative while discussing the 'excel' compact. A light percussive 'tap' is audible. (6) In the final phase, a 'ding' SFX sounds as the call-to-action text appears. The BGM fades out slightly as the narration ends on a positive note.
